name: 30680 · Winder, GA
findings: ZIP 30680 (Winder) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30680 (Winder) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30680 (Winder) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
